title: Transmission Electron Microscopy Protocol for Anaerobic Ciliates
author: Johana Rotterova
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.85uhy6w

steps.title: Initial Fixation
steps.instruction: Fix the ciliate cells and concentrate them via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Isolate 1 ml of thriving culture of ciliate cells.

steps.title: Secondary Fixation
steps.instruction: Incubate cells in glutaraldehyde buffer on ice.

substeps.instruction: Carefully replace supernatant with 1 ml of 2.5% (v/v) glutaraldehyde in 0.2M SCB (Sodium Cacodylate buffer, pH 7.2).

steps.title: Rinsing
steps.instruction: Rinse the cell pellet with buffer.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the pellet carefully with SCB three times, 15 minutes per rinse.

steps.title: Post-fixation
steps.instruction: Postfix the cells using osmium tetroxide.

substeps.instruction: Postfix the cells with 1% OsO4 in distilled water for 1 hour on ice.

steps.title: Dehydration
steps.instruction: Rinse and dehydrate cells through a graded ethanol series.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the cells with distilled water for 5 minutes.
Dehydrate in a graded ethanol series for 8 minutes each: 30%, 50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 95%, and finally three times in absolute ethanol.

steps.title: Acetone Treatment
steps.instruction: Transition cells from ethanol to acetone.

substeps.instruction: Incubate cells two times in 1:1 ethanol-acetone mixture, 15 minutes per incubation.
Incubate cells once in 2 ml of 100% acetone for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Resin Infiltration and Embedding
steps.instruction: Infiltrate cells with EPON resin and embed in capsules.

substeps.instruction: Substitute acetone with acetone-resin mixture (EPON resin Poly/Bed 812, Polysciences) and incubate for 6-12 hours.
Substitute with absolute EPON resin (Poly/Bed 812, Polysciences) three times.
Embed cells in the resin into capsules.

steps.title: Sectioning and Staining
steps.instruction: Cut ultrathin sections and apply stains.

substeps.instruction: Cut serial ultrathin sections on an Ultracut E ultramicrotome (Reichert) using a diamond knife.
Stain with lead citrate and uranyl acetate (2–3%).
